exposure: standard decision-to-delivery time interval (DDI) of ≤30 minutes
admission to the Special Care Baby Unit (SCBU)
Apgar scores of <7 at five minutes
outcome: Admission to the Special Care Baby Unit (SCBU)
cohort: Pregnant women undergoing emergency Caesarean section due to acute fetal distress, antepartum haemorrhage, or umbilical cord prolapse
finding: While there was no significant difference in perinatal outcomes for DDI ≤30 minutes vs. 31-60 minutes, DDI >60 minutes was significantly associated with increased SCBU admissions and low Apgar scores.
cross-section timing: Three audit cycles of three months each between April 2011 and June 2013
